items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He comes back to me and he begged me... Comes to my house and begged me. 'Man, forgive me.' ... I gave him the break. ... I loan him my banjo

ctx.x:
Yeah, he's getting Lucky Fowler. He got Lucky Fowler. And Lucky Fowler played a whole lot of guitar, see. And Lucky Fowler could sing and entertain. And ...(?)... couldn't get Lucky. Lucky threatened to kill him. When Lucky found out what he was doing with that bass, Lucky threatened to kill him. And they fell out.

He fell out with the guitar players. He comes back to me and he begged me... Comes to my house and begged me. "Man, forgive me. Let's go and make this little money. These are some nice people. These…
